mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 79 degrees by the Verona Public Library, but please note the elevated air quality index of 56 today.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students to design the official sticker for the November election, with submissions open until July 22. Also, residents are reminded to review the mailbox damage policy to ensure mailboxes are ready for the winter plowing season.
Enjoy some live music at Bailey's Run today, and plan for a visit to the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square happening tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a call where a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after getting their vehicle stuck on a large rock.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy the Chocolate Volcano flavor of the day, and you have until 10:30 PM tonight to get your fix at the Verona Culver's.
